headword: {成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}
gloss: contingency fee; success fee; performance-based reward

definitions.gloss: contingency fee; success fee; reward paid only on success
definitions.explanation: A payment that is owed only when a particular result is achieved, such as winning a lawsuit, closing a deal, or recovering money. Common in legal, consulting, and recruiting work, often alongside an upfront retainer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay the lawyer a contingency fee.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{着手金|ちゃくしゅきん}→着手金：29447_chakushukin⟧なし⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}⟦{制|せい}→〜制：30791_sei⟧だ。
examples.english: This contract is contingency-fee-based, with no upfront payment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回収|かいしゅう}→回収：03019_kaishuu⟧⟦できた→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦{金額|きんがく}→金額：02665_kingaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{二割|にわり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{受|う}け{取|と}る→受け取る：01883_uketoru⟧。
examples.english: They receive twenty percent of the amount recovered as a contingency fee.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{成功|せいこう}→成功：02638_seikou⟧ (success) + ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧ (reward, remuneration). The fee is conditional on a result being achieved.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}{型|がた}: contingency-fee type (arrangement)
- {成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支払|しはら}う→支払う：02116_shiharau⟧: to pay a success fee
- ⟦{完全|かんぜん}→完全：01552_kanzen⟧{成功報酬|せいこうほうしゅう}: pure contingency fee (with no retainer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{着手金|ちゃくしゅきん}→着手金：29447_chakushukin⟧: retainer fee — paid upfront when work begins, regardless of outcome
- ⟦{報酬|ほうしゅう}→報酬：12094_houshuu⟧: reward, remuneration — the general term, not tied to success
